scripts.test: npm run test:vitest && npm run test:node # npm appends CLI arguments to the final command
scripts.prepare:qmd:bundle: rm -rf build/qmd-resources && mkdir -p build/qmd-resources && cp -R "$QMD_BUNDLE_DIR/." build/qmd-resources/
scripts.dist: npm run prepare:qmd && npm run prepare:runtime && electron-vite build && electron-builder
scripts.dist:mac: if [ -n "${QMD_BUNDLE_DIR:-}" ]; then npm run prepare:qmd:bundle; else npm run prepare:qmd; fi && npm run prepare:runtime && electron-vite build && electron-builder --mac
